Backend: 34/34 new-feature tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_major_update.py. Frontend: all critical pages render with correct data-testids — Register (wrong code 400 fires), Admin MVP card, notification-bell + dropdown, /admin/approvals, /admin/payments (rows rendered), Editor XP banner + MVP self card, /editor/profile (xp-card, xp-progress-bar, burnout-card, badges-card with 7 badge testids, top-videos-card), Chat (ws-status live, voice-record-button, per-message react-btn-<id>, voice-<id> markers). critical.issue: Seed data regression — editor2@taskflow.com, editor3@taskflow.com, client2@taskflow.com all return 401 'Invalid email or password'. Only editor1 + 1 post-registration 'newuser' editor + client1 exist. Breaks prior regression suite (test_leaderboard, test_recommendations, test_workload, test_conversations, test_lifecycle, test_full_flow, etc.)

ui_bugs.issue: Unpaid row visible (status badge 'unpaid') but no 'Mark Paid' button rendered inside the row; user cannot mark unpaid editors paid from UI. API /payments/{id}/mark-paid works (backend test passes). Likely missing button render in AdminPayments.jsx row template.

Wrong access code (server returns 400 'Incorrect access code') does not surface a visible error message via .error / [role=alert] selectors; may rely on a toast outside the form. Users may not know why registration failed.

action_items: Re-run seed function to restore editor2@taskflow.com, editor3@taskflow.com, client2@taskflow.com (per /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Ensure seed is idempotent and updates passwords if users exist.
AdminPayments.jsx — render a Mark-Paid button on rows where status='unpaid'; wire to POST /api/payments/{editor_id}/mark-paid and refresh the row.
RegisterPage.jsx — surface the 400 error message from POST /auth/register into an inline alert (not just toast), using a <[role='alert']> / .error container with data-testid='register-error'.
(Cosmetic) Add data-testid='mark-paid-btn-<editor_id>' to the payment button so it's automatable.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1550 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth, tasks, chat, notifications, payments, mvp, scheduler). Size exceeds the 700-line guideline.

/messages/voice enforces 700000-byte limit but stores audio_data as base64 directly in the message doc — inline with docs' 'mocked for demo' flag. Warn on MongoDB doc-size (16MB cap); acceptable for demo.
compute_level iterates LEVEL_THRESHOLDS sequentially — correct, math matches spec (0→Rookie/1, 350→Pro Cutter/5, 1400→Cinematic Beast/10, 3200→Editing God/20). Verified.
scheduler_loop is an asyncio.create_task with bare while True + 60s sleep — OK for demo; in production needs a lock or run-once-per-pod guard (multiple replicas would multiply the work).
seed_admin/seed_users logic is likely not idempotent for editor2/editor3/client2 (they're missing on the live env). Must verify the seed function runs on startup and upserts these users.

/payments resets 'payment_paid_this_month' on the 5th via scheduler — payment_history writeback relies on that tick; the lack of a tested history fixture means history regeneration on monthly rollover isn't exercised by current tests.
Reaction endpoint accepts any emoji string with no allowlist — tiny abuse vector; consider restricting to the documented 5 emoji set (👍🔥💀😂😭).

rca of the issue: Seed regression RCA — /api/users?role=editor returns 2 editors (NovaReaper47=editor1, MysticWolf47=newuser@taskflow.com). The 'newuser' record suggests someone or some process registered manually and shadowed the expected editor2/editor3 slots, or the seed on startup never ran the 2nd/3rd editor inserts. /app/memory/test_credentials.md lists 3 editors + 2 clients but only 1 of each role is usable. Main agent should inspect the seed_users() function in server.py startup hook, ensure it is idempotent and inserts all 3 editors + 2 clients even if some users already exist. AdminPayments mark-paid RCA — API endpoint works (backend test passes), but in AdminPayments.jsx the payment-row template likely conditional-renders the action button only in a state/branch that's not reached, or the button was omitted. Check the row's JSX for an unpaid-branch button.
